issue_context.title: PVs with annotations are not being dynamically provisioned on k8s 1.26.1
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

We observed that when deplying manifests to a cluster running 1.26.1-gke.200, the StorageClass and PVC get created successfully. However, the PVC is stuck in a Pending state and no PV is provisioned.

The workaround is to add storageClassName to one of the pending PVCs on cluster, and it did go from Pending to properly provisioned a PV and reaching Bound state. 

We looked at the logs and found that according to the doc: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#class,

```
In the past, the annotation volume.beta.kubernetes.io/storage-class 
was used instead of the storageClassName attribute. This annotation
 is still working; however, it will become fully deprecated in a future 
Kubernetes release.
```

Is this annotation is fully deprecated in the new 1.26.1 release? If yes can we add this detail to documentation or release note?






### What did you expect to happen?

the PVC should not stuck in a Pending state and PV is provisioned in 1.26.1

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. Create a 1.26.1-gke.200 cluster in GKE
2. Create via yaml

```
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: sunnytest-sc
parameters:
  type: pd-ssd
provisioner: kubernetes.io/gce-pd
reclaimPolicy: Delete
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: storage-class-issue-test
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: storage-class-issue-test
  serviceName: storage-class-issue-test
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: storage-class-issue-test
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: writer
        image: busybox
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 100Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 80Mi
        command:
          - "/bin/sh"
          - "-c"
          - touch /data/${MY_POD_NAME} && while true; do echo $(date) >> /data/${MY_POD_NAME}; sleep 1; done
        env:
          - name: MY_POD_NAME
            valueFrom:
              fieldRef:
                fieldPath: metadata.name
        volumeMounts:
        - name: local-disk
          mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - apiVersion: v1
    kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
    metadata:
      annotations:
        volume.beta.kubernetes.io/storage-class: sunnytest-sc
      creationTimestamp: null
      name: cassandra-data
    spec:
      accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 10Gi
      volumeMode: Filesystem
```

### Anything else we need to know?

The error comes form the code: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/915924e64d08b7b2d3e6da81840e46d96304cdc9/pkg/controller/volume/persistentvolume/pv_controller_base.go#L275 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/915924e64d08b7b2d3e6da81840e46d96304cdc9/pkg/apis/core/validation/validation.go#L2259

There are some hypotheses here:

The annotation volume.beta.kubernetes.io/storage-class does not work on 1.26.1 any more, so a default storage class is being populated to the PVC.
For some reason, the [DefaultStorageClass admission controller](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/admission-controllers/#defaultstorageclass) did not work, so the PVC was deployed with an empty StorageClass nil.
Then the kube controller manager tried to update the PVC with the default StorageClass, which triggered the error:

comments: Annotation support seem to be still intact. Check the e2e test https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/7ad31bc8c327b66b7d1d3187ac6b040a559a5fef/test/e2e/testing-manifests/statefulset/nginx/statefulset.yaml#L25-L34

From the point of view of the code, this annotation is still in use.
I'll try to see if I can reproduce it.
It's a bug introduced in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/111467. The feature is enabled in 1.26 by default.
